label: Response Time
description: Feedback about how quickly customer support replied or resolved issues.

label: Resolution Quality
description: Feedback on whether support provided a clear, effective, and satisfactory fix.

label: Support Experience
description: Comments about friendliness, professionalism, helpfulness, or empathy from support staff.

label: Product Quality
description: Reviews about defects, craftsmanship, material quality, or overall product condition.

label: Value for Money
description: Comments on price, affordability, worth, or value relative to expectations.

label: Features and Functionality
description: Mentions of usefulness, innovation, performance, capabilities, and feature satisfaction.

label: Reliability and Durability
description: Feedback about how consistently the product works, lasts, or holds up over time.

label: Setup and Usage
description: Comments about installation, ease of use, learning curve, or day-to-day experience.

label: Seller Scam Behavior
description: Reviews describing deceptive seller behavior, fake promises, or scam-like conduct.

label: Extra Payment Requests
description: Reports of being pressured to pay more money after purchase or during a transaction.

label: Counterfeit or Misrepresentation
description: Feedback about fake products, misleading claims, or products not matching what was advertised.

label: Delivery Delays
description: Complaints or notes about slower-than-expected shipping or late delivery.

label: Damaged or Poor Condition
description: Reviews about damaged products, poor packaging, or items arriving in bad condition.

label: Order Tracking and Updates
description: Comments on updates, tracking quality, communication, or lack of visibility during fulfillment.

label: Packaging and Handling
description: Feedback about packaging quality, protective handling, and delivery presentation.

label: Website & ordering
description: Reports about order errors, processing delays, fulfillment issues, or mismatched expectations.
